title: feat: make quest badge actionable
author: tomdacatto
pr_body_excerpt:
- Replaces the static quest badge with live account counts.
- Shows unclaimed rewards as `X claimable!`, otherwise incomplete available quests as `X new!`, and hides the badge when nothing needs attention.
- Loads quest state after render and refreshes after automatic quest checks and claims; adds focused status-priority tests.

Tests: 3 focused tests, Biome, diff check, and Enter frontend production build.

gist.headline: The quest badge has plans
gist.blurb: The quest badge now checks your account before speaking up. Claimable Pollen comes first; unfinished quests get a nudge when there’s nothing to claim.
gist.summary: Replaced the static dashboard quest badge with live account counts: it shows `X claimable!` for unclaimed rewards, otherwise `X new!` for incomplete available quests, and disappears when neither needs attention.
gist.impact: Users can spot rewards ready to claim or quests ready to complete from the dashboard navigation, with the count refreshed after automatic quest checks and claims.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the Pollinations quest dashboard as a cozy garden noticeboard: a small badge highlights claimable Pollen, with unfinished quests represented by nearby seed packets. Polli, wearing a tiny tool belt, updates the badge while a friendly CRT robot watches; flowers and code-plants tie the scene to the garden.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli adjusts a lime green (#ecf874) quest badge reading '2 claimable!' on a little dashboard noticeboard while a friendly CRT robot looks on beside flower pots and code-plants. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, wears a tiny tool belt, and shares the frame with the scene, strictly pixel art and never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients over warm cream, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, soft lime green (#ecf874) glow, and dark purple (#110518) outlines; nostalgic and emotionally warm.
